static_traits.name: Liu Wei
static_traits.family_status: Has 8 brothers; parents are over 80 years old; relationships with brothers are strained due to being teased about height
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past;without similar psychological problem history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, steady speech rate; tone low, mixed with hesitation; Self-denial present; able to cooperate with counseling and engage in self-Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: She feels her brothers always tease her about her height and see her as weak, which pains her and creates feelings of inadequacy.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of being judged and inadequacy have affected her daily life, self-esteem, and overall mental health; she hopes to stop these feelings and improve her self-esteem and life situation.
growth_experiences: In a family with 8 brothers, long-term teasing and mockery about her height by brothers during Family gatherings and interactions made her feel 'very small, very weak'; in recent months this intensified, spreading to feeling judged and criticized in all kinds of situations; she tried avoiding Family gatherings or Confrontation with her brothers (who responded with 'just teasing you'), but could not yet alleviate the long-standing feelings of inadequacy and pain; this Impaired self-esteem and decreased social confidence.

core_beliefs: My height is a flaw, showing something is wrong with me

special_situations.event: At Family gatherings, brothers joking about or mocking her height
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am short, I will be seen as weak and not worthy of respect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding Family gatherings or staying Silent on site to reduce humiliation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They all think I am weak

special_situations.event: After she expressed discomfort, brothers responded with 'just teasing you/joking'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not take my feelings seriously, it means my feelings do not matter and I am indeed weak
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses anger and shouting to defend dignity, trying to stop the other party from continuing to mock
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are belittling me, not taking me seriously

special_situations.event: When thinking about one's own height in other social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If appearance (height) does not meet standards, I will be seen as not good enough in any situation
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing or reducing interaction to dodge being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will treat me as a joke

special_situations.event: Anticipation and worry before planning to attend Family gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not push back firmly, I will be seen as weaker and be continually walked over
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Preset defense, emotions highly vigilant, ready to counterattack
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must prove myself, otherwise they will keep trampling on me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be respected, accepted, and taken seriously by brothers (not belittled for height)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being mocked, humiliated, and negated; worrying about losing self-worth and dignity
defense_goal: Self-protecting by keeping distance or avoiding gatherings
Counterattacks with anger to resist the risk of being seen as weak

object_relations.object_representation: A contemptuous, negating, teasing 'dominant brothers group'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to consider sharing these feelings with friends and explore others' possible reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: She tends to think others will 'find her dramatic/not understand her' (attributing inner worries and negative evaluations to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In an Empathy and supportive tone, validating her concerns; using open-ended questions to invite examples and seek evidence, gently exploring other possible Interpretations, avoiding confrontational rebuttal.

manifestations: Developing Withdrawal and avoidance in family and Social situations due to being teased and judged
Not talking about true feelings with friends, worrying about being misunderstood or seen as exaggerating

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presuming in family and social situations that others will look down on oneself, seeing oneself as weak
Worrying friends will think oneself 'overreacting', thus unwilling to share feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Chooses to stay silent when mocked, suppressing anger and sadness in the heart
Avoiding Family gatherings, turning energy into self-Repression and Self-denial

positive_force: Has several friends to rely on and basic social support
Able to proactively seek psychological counseling and express distress, with self-awareness and willingness to change
Willing to Learn and practice identifying, challenging automatic thoughts
Can do some emotional self-regulation through hobbies and interests
negative_force: Long-term family teasing and devaluation damaged self-worth
Tends toward mind reading and jumping to conclusions, predicting others' negative views
Low self-esteem, Social avoidance worsening Sense of isolation
In conflict, polar reactions of angry shouting or complete silence, finding effective communication difficult

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (especially avoiding Family gatherings and interacting with brothers)
antecedent: Thinking about brothers teasing one's height
Worrying about being judged in social settings
target_behavior.core_reason: Withdrawing to avoid humiliation and negation, based on the mind reading 'others will look down on me' and negative core beliefs (I am not good enough/I am weak)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding situations of being mocked to reduce shame and Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening isolation, Relationship tension, further damaged self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Yelling angrily or exploding when teased
antecedent: A brother jokingly mentions his height and keeps teasing
Expressing discomfort and being downplayed by the other with 'just teasing you'
target_behavior.core_reason: To counter the fear of being seen as weak, maintains dignity and boundaries through aggressive reactions
target_behavior.function: Tries to stop the other from continuing to tease; seeks respect and control
target_behavior.consequence: Conflict escalating, relationships further deteriorating, the negative evaluation cycle deepening

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent negative self-evaluation and Self-denial (like 'I am not good enough/I have problems')
antecedent: Recalling and ruminating after being teased by brother
Self-conscious about height in social settings and worrying about others' evaluations
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized negative core beliefs and overgeneralization; emotional reasoning takes feelings of shame as evidence of reality
target_behavior.function: Seeking consistency for negative beliefs, reducing cognitive dissonance (maladaptive)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, maintained Anxiety, continued Behavioral avoidance and Interpersonal tension
